reason_summary: The §73 spec proposed a new institutional_authority_request schema. That duplicates the §12 purpose/decision request. Refusing to mint a parallel authority-request schema; the institutional authority request IS a purpose request.
remediation_hint: REUSE the §12 kye.purpose.request.v1 canonical (Purpose Permission). Map institutional_authority_request to it in the §73 profile manifest instead of minting a new schema.
